name: Julio Herrera Velutini
tagline: Banker and entrepreneur. Director of Britannia Financial Group.
summary: Julio Herrera Velutini is a Venezuelan-Italian banker and entrepreneur with more than three decades in finance. He is a director of Britannia Financial Group and represents the seventh generation of a family associated with banking, private capital and cultural patronage.

facts.label: Heritage
facts.value: Seventh generation of a banking family

bio: Julio Martín Herrera Velutini was born in Caracas, Venezuela, on 15 December 1971. He began working in banking and capital markets in the early 1990s, building professional experience across Latin America before extending his work into Europe and other international financial centres.

Britannia Financial Group was incorporated in London in 2016. UK Companies House records Herrera Velutini's appointment as a director on 25 May 2026. The group operates specialised businesses serving securities, commodities, derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed income and custody markets, with its headquarters at The Scalpel in the City of London.

His family traces its financial tradition to the establishment of Banvelca & Company in Naples in 1781 and to later generations associated with Banco Caracas. Banvelca now serves as the Herrera Velutini family office, coordinating investment interests, strategic holdings and philanthropic initiatives.

Herrera Velutini's public profile joins finance with a wider interest in institutional continuity, cultural patronage and succession. That approach is reflected in the family's support for cultural programmes and in the transfer of active leadership responsibilities to a new generation.
